Container.Name: debridup
Container.Overview:
Private, self-hosted uptime monitoring for debrid providers.
Before applying this template, create the encryption-key file using the command in the linked Unraid guide. Keep the Data path on a pool device (normally /mnt/cache) because DebridUp uses SQLite. If your pool is not named cache, change both host paths to match it.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: debrid uptime monitoring torbox premiumize real debrid alldebrid status
Container.Requires: An encryption-key file created before the first start. AMD64 or ARM64 Unraid host.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database and application data. Keep this on a pool device rather than /mnt/user for reliable SQLite performance. If your pool is not named cache, change this path.

Config.Name: Encryption key file
Config.Description: A base64-encoded 32-byte key. Create this file before starting with the command in the linked Unraid guide. This path must match your selected appdata pool.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port used to open the DebridUp dashboard.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Required on first start. This becomes the single administrator password.

Config.Name: Encryption key file in container
Config.Description: Internal path for the encryption key. Leave unchanged.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID DebridUp runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody user, which normally owns appdata.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID DebridUp runs as. 100 is Unraid's users group.
